notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). No StrategyWiki page under "Elden Ring Nightreign" or "Elden Ring: Nightreign". eldenring.fandom.com answers the API under "Elden Ring Nightreign" (not under "Elden Ring: Nightreign"), with about 123 linked pages, including "Nightlords", "Shifting Earth", "Mountaintop", "Rotted Woods", "Expeditions", "Nightfarers" and "Elden Ring Nightreign: The Forsaken Hollows"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "CL" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 2622380 as "ELDEN RING NIGHTREIGN". 28 of 37 Steam achievements are hidden. Four hidden ones ("Mountaintop", "The Crater", "Rotted Woods", "Noklateo, the Shrouded City") sit right before the visible Shifting Earth achievement in the Steam list, and Fandom links "Mountaintop" and "Rotted Woods" from the game page, so they go to the Shifting Earth chapter; that is an inference. The other 24 hidden ones sit in Expeditions and Nightlords. Some of the later hidden ones have lower unlock rates (18% to 53%) and may come from an update or expansion, but nothing in the data says which.
